doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Under the Articles of Association, the board of directors of the Company (the "Board of Directors") consists of 12 Directors, whose terms expire at the close of the AGM held three years following their appointment.
finding: The board has 12 seats on staggered three-year terms, so its membership turns over gradually and no single AGM resets it.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Board of Directors has one Executive Director and eleven Non-Executive Directors. ... According to the criteria of the Dutch Code and the Board Rules, all Non-Executive Directors (including the Chairman) presently qualify as Independent Directors.
finding: A one-tier board: the CEO is the only executive director and all eleven non-executives, including the chair, are independent, so management is outnumbered 11 to 1 on every vote.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: No shareholder, group of shareholders or any other entity has any right to propose, nominate or appoint Directors beyond those rights available to all shareholders under general Dutch corporate law.
finding: The French, German and Spanish state holders have no special right to name directors, so the board is not a delegation of governments.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: In practice, this means that at all times the Board of Directors needs to have: (i) two Directors who should also be French Defence Outside Directors ... two Directors who should also be German Defence Outside Directors
finding: State interests still reach the board indirectly: two directors must also sit as French and two as German Defence Outside Directors of the national defence holdings, with the states' consent.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: also ensuring that at least one third of Directors' positions are either renewed or replaced every year for a term of three years.
finding: The nomination rules force a rolling renewal of a third of the board each year, which favours continuity of view over abrupt change.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: A high-performing ... forward-looking ... Board that delivers long-term value
finding: The board's own skills-matrix graphic defines its purpose as delivering long-term value.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Seven of the Board members have solid Aerospace Industry experience, while Digital Transformation skills are represented by four Board members, and three members have extensive Defence Industry experience.
finding: Seven of twelve directors have aerospace experience, so programme and industrial cases get informed challenge; defence and digital depth are thinner.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Chairman of the Supervisory Board of IONOS Group SE ... Chairman Europe of Warburg Pincus
finding: The 2025 chair, Rene Obermann, came from technology and private equity (IONOS, Warburg Pincus), not from aerospace.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Number of meetings in 2025 11 7 6 6 Average attendance rate in 2025 95.45%
finding: The board met 11 times in 2025 (Audit 7, RNGC 6, ECSC 6) with 95% attendance: a monthly rhythm, so big items can be taken at a scheduled meeting.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Matters that require Board of Directors' approval include, among others, the following items (by Simple Majority below unless otherwise noted): any change in the nature and scope of the business of the Company; ... location of existing activities that are material to the Company
finding: The reserved list starts with any change in the nature and scope of the business and covers relocation of material activities, so a new business line or footprint move goes to the board.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: For the Board of Directors to make a decision on a Qualified Majority matter, at least ten of the Directors must be present or represented.
finding: Qualified Majority matters need ten of twelve directors present, a high quorum that makes the biggest decisions deliberate.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: These principles include acting in the best interests of the Company and its stakeholders, devoting necessary time and attention to the carrying out of their duties, and avoiding any and all conflicts of interest.
finding: Directors are bound to the company and its stakeholders, not to shareholders alone, the Dutch stakeholder model.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Chairman of the Board and the Lead Independent Director (and Chair of the RNGC) engage with shareholders ... remuneration policy including executive compensation, Board of Directors' composition (including diversity and skills)
finding: The chair and the lead independent director run the investor dialogue themselves, mainly on pay and board composition.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Maintaining a robust governance structure was a key priority, with the Board focusing on enhancing the Company's internal resilience against a spectrum of risks. ... Regular review of top company risks and opportunities: The Board conducted scheduled and ad-hoc reviews
finding: Resilience against risk is a stated board priority, with scheduled and ad-hoc reviews of the top risks.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Board maintains a proactive and ongoing search for potential new Non-Executive Directors. This process is highly targeted, with a particular emphasis on identifying candidates who possess profound and relevant expertise ... and the technological challenges and opportunities facing the aerospace industry.
finding: Board recruiting targets expertise in the industry's technology challenges, consistent with a board that wants to judge technology readiness itself.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Board of Directors holds an annual off-site meeting to review and refine the Company's strategic priorities.
finding: Strategy is revisited once a year at an off-site, so the board sets direction on an annual cycle rather than reacting deal by deal.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Every three years, as part of the Board of Directors' continuous review of its performance, a formal evaluation of the functioning of the Board of Directors and its Committees is conducted with the assistance of a third-party expert.
finding: The board submits itself to an external evaluation every three years, with internal reviews in between.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Board evaluation results were largely positive, highlighting the Board's strong performance and effectiveness, led by a knowledgeable and committed Chairman. ... The Board's culture supports open debates by embracing diverse perspectives.
finding: The 2025 self-evaluation describes a cohesive board with open debate under its chair: no sign of open conflict with management.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: executive succession plan, Board oversight (strategy, risks, capital allocation, culture), and
finding: The board grades itself on oversight of strategy, risk, capital allocation and culture, the four areas it treats as its job.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Audit Committee (AC) consists of five Non-Executive Directors: Stephan Gemkow ... (Chairman), Mark Dunkerley, Catherine Guillouard, Dr. Doris Hopke and Antony Wood.
finding: Stephan Gemkow chairs the Audit Committee (since the 2025 AGM); its members are the finance-literate core of the board.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Pursuant to the Board Rules, the Audit Committee, which is required to meet at least four times a year, makes recommendations to the Board of Directors on the approval of the annual financial statements and the interim accounts ... maintains a strong link to the Ethics, Compliance and Sustainability Committee
finding: The Audit Committee prepares the accounts approval and oversees the enterprise risk system, linked to the ethics committee: the committee that tests a programme's cash and risk case.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Ethics, Compliance and Sustainability Committee (ECSC) is composed of six Non-Executive Directors
finding: A six-member Ethics, Compliance and Sustainability Committee exists alongside Audit and RNGC; there is no separate safety or technology committee.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Remuneration Nomination and Governance ... (RNGC) is composed of four Non-Executive Directors: Amparo Moraleda (Chair), Jean Pierre Clamadieu, Mark Dunkerley, and Dr. Doris Hopke.
finding: As of the FY2025 report Amparo Moraleda chaired the RNGC, which nominates directors and sets executive pay.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Pursuant to the Board Rules, the Chair of the RNGC automatically fulfils the function of "Lead Independent Director". ... organising the annual appraisal of the Chairman's performance by the Board of Directors and ... acting as an intermediary for, and between, the other Directors when necessary.
finding: Whoever chairs the RNGC is the lead independent director, who appraises the chair and mediates between directors.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: the RNGC proactively supported continuity of leadership by anticipating the transition of the Audit Committee Chairmanship and appointing a successor Chair in advance to ensure a smooth and effective handover.
finding: The board plans its own handovers early, the same pattern it uses for executive succession.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: It is the forum where information or requests for approval destined for the Board of Directors are discussed and approved. ... The CEO is the only Executive Director within the Board of Directors
finding: Board items are first agreed in the Executive Committee, so the board sees a single management case brought by the CEO.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Company's Remuneration Policy was adopted by the 2025 Annual General Meeting ("AGM") by a majority (96.42%) of the votes cast. ... the RNGC observed that abstentions on the Remuneration Policy were primarily driven by the long-standing voting principles of certain large shareholders.
finding: The pay policy the board designed passed with 96%; the abstentions came from some large holders' standing voting principles.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: delivering long-term sustainable returns for all shareholders and other stakeholders ... is consistent and aligned with the interests of long-term shareholders, whilst also taking into consideration the employment conditions of the Company's employees
finding: The board states its pay philosophy in long-term terms: returns for long-term shareholders and other stakeholders, with employees' conditions in view.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Before setting the targets to be proposed for adoption by the Board of Directors, the RNGC analyses scenarios with respect to the potential targets and considers the resulting outcomes, including financial.
finding: Targets are set after scenario analysis by the RNGC, the same scenario habit the board uses for strategy.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: For the 2025 grant (performance period related to financial years 2026, 2027 and 2028) the LTI Sustainability component will be comprised of the following two metrics ... Granted in 2025 Vesting date Guillaume Faury 14,404 May 2029
finding: The long-term award measures three financial years (2026-2028) and vests about four years after grant (May 2029): a medium-term, not a decade-long, pay horizon.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Best practice provision 3.1.2 vi of the Dutch Code recommends that any shares awarded to the Chief Executive Officer ... a minimum five year holding period for such awarded shares; however, the Company believes that potential deviations from this recommendation are significantly limited by the Company's share ownership guidelines
finding: Airbus does not apply the Dutch Code's five-year holding period to the CEO's shares, relying on a share ownership guideline instead: a shorter lock-in than the code asks.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: the Board of Directors, with support of the Audit Committee, supervises the ERM system strategy and business risks and opportunities, as well as the design and effectiveness of the ERM system
finding: The board itself supervises the enterprise risk system and the business risks, with the Audit Committee's support.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The Board of Directors recognises the inherent limitations of the Company's internal risk management and control systems. While the Company continually endeavours to improve its processes and procedures, these systems cannot provide absolute certainty that all relevant risks have been identified or are effectively managed.
finding: The board's formal declaration admits that risk systems cannot catch everything, which argues for buffers rather than relying on controls.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Pursuant to the shareholders' resolutions adopted at the Annual General Meeting (the "AGM") held on 15 April 2025 ... limited to 0.18% of Airbus SE's authorised share capital ... funding Airbus SE and any of its subsidiaries, provided that such powers shall be limited to 0.3% of Airbus SE's authorised share capital.
finding: The board's own authority to issue shares is tiny (0.18% and 0.3% of authorised capital), so any real equity raise would need shareholders, including the states.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: At the AGM held on 15 April 2025, the Board of Directors was authorised for a period of 18 months from the date of such AGM to repurchase shares of Airbus SE ... as long as, upon such repurchase, Airbus SE would not hold more than 10% of Airbus SE's issued share capital
finding: Buybacks run under an 18-month AGM authority capped at 10% of issued capital, which frames the size of any capital return the board can approve.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: all the Directors shall be free to express their own views.
finding: Under the state shareholders' pact, directors vote freely on the board's reserved matters: the states coordinate as shareholders, not through directors.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Sogepa and GZBV shall consult each other on any draft resolution intending to modify the Board Rules and/or the Articles of Association. Unless Sogepa and GZBV agree to vote in favour together of such draft resolution, the Shareholders shall vote against such draft resolution.
finding: Unless France's Sogepa and Germany's GZBV both agree, the state pact's holders must vote against any change to the Board Rules or the Articles, so either state can swing the pact's votes against a governance change at the AGM.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: with aviation safety and security continuing to be its highest priority.
finding: The Board Report ranks aviation safety and security as the highest priority while the company ramps up.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: which aims at ensuring the Company's long-term viability in the decades ahead.
finding: The innovation strategy is justified by viability over decades, the board's long-horizon framing of R&D.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: Although the Company has significant order backlogs for its commercial aircraft, continued and increasing market competition (through the further entry of new competitors or the launch by competitors of new products or services) could have a negative impact on the Company's revenues
finding: The board's risk factors name new entrants and rival product launches as a threat even with a record backlog: it watches rival launches, not just Boeing.

doc: Airbus SE Report of the Board of Directors 2025 (issued 18 February 2026)
speaker: Airbus SE Board of Directors (Board Report, as filed)
quote: The composition of the Board of Directors until the 2026 Annual General Meeting is presented below ... IreneRummelhoff* 2022, 2028 (58,F,Norwegian) previous re-election in 2025
finding: Irene Rummelhoff (Norwegian) is a non-executive director since 2022, re-elected in 2025 with a term to 2028, in the board list valid until the 2026 AGM; the evidence gives no background for her, and no 2026 source records her leaving.
